DIALOGUE_TEXT_1: At last, you have awakened. The spirit of Balkion welcomes you.
DIALOGUE_TEXT_2: Nice to meet you. But this is strange... I feel as though I already knew you were going to say that.
DIALOGUE_TEXT_3: ...It is merely a temporary phenomenon that occurs during the process of linking with the castle. Please do not worry.
DIALOGUE_TEXT_4: It has grown dark! At night, the monsters become far stronger, so we must be careful.
DIALOGUE_TEXT_5: Trying to arm the heroes and reinforce the castle walls... our funds are far more lacking than I expected.
DIALOGUE_TEXT_6: I understand, my lord. As it happens, there is already a line of people who have heard of your fame and come seeking your aid. If you resolve the [Quest], they will gladly pay in gold coins.
DIALOGUE_TEXT_7: I suddenly feel a chill. It is a cold presence that does not belong on these blue-green plains.
DIALOGUE_TEXT_8: Those are wolves carrying the chill of the north. It seems the castle's magic has awakened their instincts.
DIALOGUE_TEXT_9: The wolves have found the location of Balkion Castle. Confirm with your own eyes whether the lord of the castle has truly returned.
DIALOGUE_TEXT_10: The lord of Balkion has appeared once more! Request reinforcements from the chieftain!
DIALOGUE_TEXT_11: Before those wretches can nurture even a spark of hope, our assault force will go and trample it underfoot!
DIALOGUE_TEXT_12: Not bad for a brat of a lord. Shamans, support the assault force.
DIALOGUE_TEXT_13: My lord! Enemies are closing in from the air as well! Watch the skies!
DIALOGUE_TEXT_14: Do they mean to cover even the sky...? Yet even this sight does not feel unfamiliar. Why...?
DIALOGUE_TEXT_15: Enough playing around. This castle must vanish so that our [Echo of the Abyss] may bring the end!
DIALOGUE_TEXT_16: [Echo of the Abyss]...? Were they not mere raiders?
DIALOGUE_TEXT_17: Th-this cannot be! Defeated by no more than a lord barely returned to life...! But do not rejoice just yet. Next, 'they' will come...
DIALOGUE_TEXT_18: The enemies have fallen into great confusion after losing their commander! But the remnants that remain are still making one final desperate stand.
DIALOGUE_TEXT_19: Poison spiders are beginning to swarm into the place the orcs have vacated. Beware the venom they release when they die.
DIALOGUE_TEXT_20: That sticky stuff is thoroughly unpleasant.
DIALOGUE_TEXT_21: We have come to purge the castle where the orcs failed. The magic of Balkion shall become an offering to [Echo of the Abyss]!
DIALOGUE_TEXT_22: [Echo of the Abyss]? You lot again!
DIALOGUE_TEXT_23: Priests behind the sturdy shields of heavy infantry... what a troublesome combination.
DIALOGUE_TEXT_24: The priests' healing magic will be troublesome. We must strike through the gaps in their armor before the healing begins.
DIALOGUE_TEXT_25: Gain altitude! Today, the skies of Balkion shall be covered in the flames of death. Begin the assault!
DIALOGUE_TEXT_26: My lord, focus on anti-air defense!
DIALOGUE_TEXT_27: Send the mages and golems forward! Today Balkion will fall, and we shall answer the call of the abyss!
DIALOGUE_TEXT_28: You are formidable, lord... but the march of the abyss shall never cease...
DIALOGUE_TEXT_29: Now that the humans have withdrawn, is it a swarm of frogs this time...? No, wait. Are those things... descending by parachute?
DIALOGUE_TEXT_30: Correct. Because [Echo of the Abyss] has twisted even the roots of the forest, even common sense itself has begun to collapse.
DIALOGUE_TEXT_31: Intercept the frogs riding the wind while they are still in the air. If their parachutes fail, they will plummet.
DIALOGUE_TEXT_32: Bringing them down is not the end of it. Even after crashing into the ground, they are crawling back up with stubborn persistence.
DIALOGUE_TEXT_33: The corrupted life force of the forest has made them vicious. Do not let your guard down against either the air or the ground.
DIALOGUE_TEXT_34: A castle where life blossoms? No, this is a nest where death abides. Embrace eternal rest!
DIALOGUE_TEXT_35: Even the elves' eyes have grown clouded. They are fixated on destruction alone, as though bewitched by something.
DIALOGUE_TEXT_36: They believe the world can no longer be restored. That is why they seek to hasten its end with their own hands.
DIALOGUE_TEXT_37: So, long-range fire from the elves. There is venom on the tips of their arrows. Let your guard down and they will pierce you in an instant.
DIALOGUE_TEXT_38: O wind, rise and rage! Lead them into the swamp of the abyss!
DIALOGUE_TEXT_39: The Green Eagles in the sky and the wolf warriors on the ground are attacking in coordination!
DIALOGUE_TEXT_40: They even drew in the ancient spirit Ents... With those giants at the fore, they mean to crush the castle gates outright.
DIALOGUE_TEXT_41: As life blossoms, suffering only deepens. Tear this cycle of pain apart together with Balkion!
DIALOGUE_TEXT_42: The forest itself will weep at your name. You are the true stain that must be erased from these woods.
DIALOGUE_TEXT_43: Pitiful human... You refuse death to the very end. Sink together with your stubbornness into the waves of the abyss!
DIALOGUE_TEXT_44: Impressive, Castle Lord... But the forest will never die. We shall bloom again... from within the abyss...
DIALOGUE_TEXT_45: Wait, what is that grotesque lump of metal? It's mixed in among the monsters!
DIALOGUE_TEXT_46: It is a war machine fitted with a self-destruct device! Beware its devastating explosion!
DIALOGUE_TEXT_47: This sinister, chilling aura... at last, what was bound to come has arrived. The stench of corpses rises from beneath the earth.
DIALOGUE_TEXT_48: The resistance of the living ends here. Balkion shall soon become a great tombstone, and the end will be complete.
DIALOGUE_TEXT_49: Death magic has been detected! My lord, this time as well... no, we must stop it without fail.
DIALOGUE_TEXT_50: This time as well? Balkion, what did you just say? You're hiding something from me, aren't you?
DIALOGUE_TEXT_51: There's no end to them. Even with their bones shattered, they knit themselves back together and crawl on with relentless persistence.
DIALOGUE_TEXT_52: My lord, you cannot watch only the front! Ghosts are scaling the walls by clinging to the shadows!
DIALOGUE_TEXT_53: Great Hammer troops! Bring down the arrogant foundations of this fortress, so that the abyss may swallow this land whole!
DIALOGUE_TEXT_54: Grant them the blessing of the abyss!
DIALOGUE_TEXT_55: Take down the black mages before they complete the curse!
DIALOGUE_TEXT_56: Kahahaha! Offer up those miserable lives to the fireworks of death!
DIALOGUE_TEXT_57: Undead cavalry that became even stronger in death... this is the worst.
DIALOGUE_TEXT_58: Legions of the Abyss, launch a full assault! The sun of Balkion shall set, and the eternal abyssal night shall come!
DIALOGUE_TEXT_59: Still holding out? But your life force has a clear limit. In the end... you too shall become one of the abyssal legions!
DIALOGUE_TEXT_60: Urgh... felled by the blade of a mere mortal... But do not rejoice... the abyss has already sunk into even your soul...
DIALOGUE_TEXT_61: The lich has perished, but the remaining skeletons are instinctively gnawing at the castle walls!
DIALOGUE_TEXT_62: Are they nothing more than empty shells without a master? Then I shall grind them to dust down to their very last bone.
DIALOGUE_TEXT_63: You're holding on better than expected... But can you withstand the advance of the Abyss Knights as well?
DIALOGUE_TEXT_64: My lord, an ancient seal beneath the fortress has been broken, and ancient [Relics] have revealed themselves.
DIALOGUE_TEXT_65: Relics? Legendary arms were sleeping beneath the walls all this time? I can feel the magic in them... but they are not yet whole.
DIALOGUE_TEXT_66: That is because they remain dormant. If we inject them with mana essence extracted from the [Dungeon], they will regain their true power.
DIALOGUE_TEXT_67: Good. Then we must dispatch the heroes at once.
DIALOGUE_TEXT_68: No way... wasn't it all over? Why are those monsters showing up again?
DIALOGUE_TEXT_69: The heart of [Echo of the Abyss] is throbbing. It has forcibly bound the souls of the fallen monsters and shaped them anew.
DIALOGUE_TEXT_70: My lord, as the night deepens, [Power of the Abyss] has completely erased the presence of some enemies!
DIALOGUE_TEXT_71: They're creeping closer hidden in the darkness... it's not easy to deal with them when they can't be seen.
DIALOGUE_TEXT_72: You must reveal them with skills or the castle's attacks, or deploy heroes with [Stealth Detection].
DIALOGUE_TEXT_73: No way... that black tide filling the horizon... don't tell me all of that is those monsters? That's impossible, I can't even see the end of it!
DIALOGUE_TEXT_74: The abyssal monsters are rampaging all at once. My lord, you must pull yourself together! The walls will be swallowed up at this rate!
DIALOGUE_TEXT_75: Ugh... my head... Where am I? Somehow, this place feels familiar...
DIALOGUE_TEXT_76: Those slimes... It looks like they're coming to attack the castle!
TIP_DESC_1: You can rebirth at any time using the button at the top left.
TIP_DESC_2: Heroes can be recruited with [Gems] and [Medals].
TIP_DESC_3: Upon rebirth, you can earn [Medals] in proportion to the wave you reached.
TIP_DESC_4: You can obtain [Relic Materials] in dungeons.
TIP_DESC_5: In Infinite Ranking Battles, you can earn [Gems] and [Honor Coins].
TIP_DESC_6: 1a is 1,000, and 1b is 1,000,000. 1c is 1,000,000,000, which is 1 followed by 9 zeros.
TIP_DESC_7: If you delete the game without logging in, all data will be lost, so please log in if possible.
TIP_DESC_8: Heroes are made up of four races: Human, Elf, Orc, and Undead.
TIP_DESC_9: You can own up to [10 Heroes].
TIP_DESC_10: You can collect materials in dungeons to purchase or upgrade relics.
TIP_DESC_11: Each dungeon has races that are restricted from entry.
TIP_DESC_13: [Medals] used for hero enhancement are refunded 100% when the hero is dismissed.
TIP_DESC_14: Hero enhancement levels are not reset even after [Rebirth].
TIP_DESC_15: Relics do not disappear after rebirth.
TIP_DESC_16: The higher the wave at which you rebirth, the more [Medals] you can earn.
TIP_DESC_17: If progress slows down too much, it is recommended to enhance using the medals obtained after [Rebirth].
TIP_DESC_18: Heroes and enemies have two attack types: physical attacks and magic attacks.
TIP_DESC_19: Heroes surrounded by a [Yellow Shield] are immune to physical attacks.
TIP_DESC_20: Heroes surrounded by a [Blue Shield] are immune to magic attacks.
TIP_DESC_21: Heroes surrounded by a [Red Shield] defend against 99% of both physical and magic attacks.
TIP_DESC_22: When a hero evolves, their skills and stats become even stronger.
TIP_DESC_23: [Knockback] pushes enemies backward, while [Blow] launches enemies into the air.
TIP_DESC_25: Rewards for Daily Ranking Battles and Infinite Ranking Battles are sent to the mailbox after they end.
TIP_DESC_26: Upgrading [Multishot] increases the number of projectiles fired from the castle at once.
TIP_DESC_27: Upgrading [Bounce Shot] allows castle projectiles to bounce and attack additionally.
TIP_DESC_28: If you purchase a game speed increase item in the [Shop], the game's progress speed will become faster.
TIP_DESC_29: The [Elf's Arcane Art] skill has a certain chance to skip the next wave when clearing a wave.
TIP_DESC_30: The [Divine Blessing] skill has a certain chance to greatly increase the game speed for a short time when clearing specific waves.
TIP_DESC_31: You can enhance the castle and heroes using [Medals], and these enhancements remain even after rebirth.
TIP_DESC_32: You can increase the levels of the castle, heroes, and quests using [Gold], but they are reset upon rebirth.
TIP_DESC_33: Try quickly tapping the Gold Goblin that appears during the game 10 times.
TIP_DESC_34: If you press the horn, you can quickly call the enemies of the next wave.
TIP_DESC_35: If you upgrade [Arcane of Life] in [Castle-Temple], you can continue as many times as your life count even if the castle is destroyed.
TIP_DESC_36: To quickly earn quest gold, try collecting good 'Relics'.
TIP_DESC_37: Each time you rebirth, the amount of quest gold increases and the time decreases.
TIP_DESC_38: If a 5-star hero evolves into a 6-star hero, the maximum gold level increases to 1100.
TIP_DESC_39: When a hero evolves, a race skill is unlocked and the performance of the unique skill increases.
TIP_DESC_40: Click the speed button at the top left to switch between 1.5x, 2x, and default speed.
TIP_DESC_41: Knight Order level increases every 100 floors and can be checked in the profile at the top left.
TIP_DESC_42: Relics do not appear as duplicates. To increase the chance of higher-rarity relics appearing, it is best to purchase lower-rarity relics first.
TIP_DESC_43: Melee heroes block many enemies and prevent them from passing. If there are many enemies, it is recommended to place melee heroes.
TIP_DESC_44: After selecting a hero, you can drag them to move them wherever you want.
TIP_DESC_45: If you press and hold a hero in the barracks, you can view detailed information.
